checklist.step: Configure the release gate on filing submission
actions: On receipt of the submission confirmation from the disposition tracker, set a release-gate flag in the policy admin system for every prior-approval and file-and-use state on the filing.
Record the gate's earliest-possible-use date as blank pending disposition.
Confirm the gate is visible on the product release plan.
checklist.done: a release gate is configured for every gated state with no earliest-use date set.

checklist.step: Confirm use-and-file and informational states are not gated
actions: Cross-check the filing determination log for any state classified use-and-file or informational/file-for-record.
Confirm no release gate is applied to those states, since use may proceed on submission per the determination.
Record the confirmation on the release plan.
checklist.done: use-and-file/informational states show no gate, consistent with the determination log.

checklist.step: Subscribe the release gate to the disposition tracker
actions: Link each gated state's release-gate record to its corresponding disposition tracker row so a status change triggers a gate review.
Confirm the linkage is bidirectional — the gate references the tracker row ID and vice versa.
Test the linkage once by manually updating a tracker row status and confirming the gate review task fires.
checklist.done: every gate record is linked to its disposition tracker row.

checklist.step: Monitor for disposition events
actions: Check the disposition tracker daily for any state moving to Approved, Filed/Closed or deemer-satisfied.
For a deemer state, independently confirm the deemer computation (submission date plus statutory review period) before treating the deemer as satisfied.
Log the disposition event date on the gate record.
checklist.done: every disposition event is captured on the gate record with the deemer computation independently confirmed where applicable.

checklist.step: Compute the earliest-possible-use date on disposition
actions: For an approval, set the earliest-possible-use date to the approval date or a later date specified in the approval letter.
For a deemer, set it to the deemer-satisfied date.
Record the computation basis and source document on the gate record.
checklist.done: the earliest-possible-use date is computed and sourced for every disposed state.

checklist.step: Release the gate in the policy admin system
actions: In the policy admin system, open the product's rate/form configuration for the disposed state.
Set the effective-use date to the computed earliest-possible-use date and clear the gate flag.
Have a second Insurance Product Manager or the Compliance Officer confirm the release before saving.
checklist.done: the gate is cleared in the policy admin system with a second-person confirmation, dated on or after the earliest-possible-use date.

checklist.step: Verify no downstream system pre-loaded the ungated rate/form
actions: Check the rating engine and any pre-load staging environment for the state's rate/form.
Confirm no policy was quoted, bound or renewed using the gated rate/form before release.
Log any pre-load finding to the Insurance Product Manager immediately.
checklist.done: no downstream system shows use of a gated rate/form before its release date, or a finding is escalated.

checklist.step: Handle an emergency-hold override request
actions: Where business urgency requests an early release, require a written risk acceptance from the Chief Risk Officer citing the specific business reason.
Confirm Regulatory Counsel has assessed the regulatory exposure of an early release.
Record the override, its approver and its rationale on the gate record; overrides never apply to prior-approval states without an actual approval or satisfied deemer.
checklist.done: any override is written, dually approved and rationale-documented; no prior-approval state is released without approval/deemer.

checklist.step: Track states still gated as September 30 approaches
actions: Pull the release-gate dashboard weekly starting 60 days before September 30.
Flag any state without a disposition event on file.
Escalate flagged states to the Compliance Officer with the current disposition tracker status.
checklist.done: gated states are tracked weekly with flags escalated ahead of September 30.

checklist.step: Escalate a state that will miss September 30 finalization
actions: Where a state's gate cannot clear before September 30, assess the CMS finalization impact — delayed plan availability or an off-cycle correction.

Present options in writing to the Chief Risk Officer and product sponsor: delay launch in that state, launch on prior-approved forms/rates, or accept a delayed CMS finalization with counsel's guidance.
Record the decision and owner on the gate record.
checklist.done: every state at risk of missing September 30 has a written, owned decision.

checklist.step: Reconcile all gates against final CMS finalization
actions: Confirm every gated state either cleared before finalization or has a recorded, approved exception.
Confirm the CMS-finalized plan/rate data matches only cleared, disposed states.
Record the reconciliation result and any residual gap on the release-gate dashboard.
checklist.done: CMS finalization reflects only cleared states, or a recorded, approved exception exists.

checklist.step: Communicate cleared states to downstream release management
actions: Publish the list of cleared states and effective-use dates to the product release plan.
Confirm the release notes for the plan-year deployment reference the correct disposition/deemer basis per state.
Circulate the finalized release plan to Underwriting, Claims and Contact Center Ops ahead of go-live.
checklist.done: the release plan and release notes correctly reflect cleared states and their basis.

checklist.step: Log any use-before-clearance finding as a compliance breach
actions: Open a breach record for any confirmed use before gate clearance, distinct from a routine exception.
Record the member/policy impact, root cause and immediate corrective action, such as re-rating or a refund.
Route to Regulatory Counsel for a mandatory self-report assessment.
checklist.done: any use-before-clearance finding is logged as a breach with corrective action and a counsel self-report assessment.

checklist.step: Retain the gate record
actions: File the gate configuration, disposition linkage, earliest-use-date computation and release confirmation in the compliance evidence repository.
Apply the 7-year-from-withdrawal retention label.
Confirm the record is indexed by state and product.
checklist.done: the gate record is filed, retention-labeled and indexed by state and product.

checklist.step: Close out the release-gate cycle for the plan year
actions: Confirm every gate for the plan year is either cleared or has an approved, documented exception.
Archive the plan year's gate dashboard and open a fresh dashboard for the next cycle.
Report the closed cycle's on-time clearance rate to the Compliance Committee.
checklist.done: the plan year's release-gate cycle is fully closed, archived and reported.

testing.step: Build the population of gated states for the plan-year cycle
actions: Extract every release-gate record configured for the plan-year cycle from the policy admin system.
Reconcile the count to the prior-approval and file-and-use state list from the determination log.
Confirm no use-and-file or informational state was mistakenly included in the gated population.
testing.done: population reconciles to the determination log's prior-approval/file-and-use state list.

testing.step: Reconcile gate release dates to disposition tracker events
actions: Match each gate release date to the disposition event date on the disposition tracker.
List any gate released with no matching disposition event as an automatic exception.
Confirm the gate release date is on or after, never before, the matched disposition event date.
testing.done: gate releases match disposition events or exceptions are logged.

testing.step: Select the sample and document the selection method
actions: Take 100% of gate overrides and any confirmed use-before-clearance findings.
Take a random sample of 15 additional gate records (seeded, reproducible).
Record the seed, the population size and the selection date.
testing.done: the sample is drawn and reproducible, covering all overrides and breach findings.

testing.step: Independently recompute the earliest-possible-use date
actions: For sampled approval-based gates, confirm the approval letter date and any later specified effective date.
For sampled deemer-based gates, independently recompute the deemer-satisfied date from the submission date and statutory review period.
Compare to the recorded earliest-possible-use date.
testing.done: recomputed dates match the recorded figures or a finding is logged.

testing.step: Verify policy admin configuration matches the gate record
actions: For each sampled gate, open the policy admin system's rate/form configuration for that state.
Confirm the effective-use date configured matches the gate record's earliest-possible-use date.
Confirm no earlier quote/bind/renewal transaction used the rate/form.
testing.done: policy admin configuration and transaction history match the gate record, or a finding is logged.

testing.step: Test override justification and dual approval
actions: For each sampled override, confirm a written risk acceptance from the Chief Risk Officer and counsel's regulatory exposure assessment exist.
Confirm no prior-approval state was released under an override without an actual approval/deemer.
Confirm the override rationale on file is specific to the business reason, not a generic boilerplate justification.
testing.done: overrides are properly justified and dually approved, or a finding is logged.

testing.step: Trace CMS finalization to cleared states only
actions: Confirm the CMS-finalized plan/rate data for each sampled state matches only a cleared gate.
Flag any finalized state with no corresponding cleared gate record.
Confirm the finalization date is on or after the gate's earliest-possible-use date.
testing.done: CMS finalization reflects cleared gates only, or a finding is logged.

testing.step: Recompute the on-time clearance rate
actions: Compute the percentage of gated states cleared before September 30 across the full population.
Compare to the internal 100% on-time target and confirm every exception has an approved, documented basis.
Trend the clearance rate against the prior plan year to identify any deteriorating pattern.
testing.done: the on-time clearance rate is computed and every exception is supported.

testing.step: Log every exception with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise a tracker issue per exception found in testing.
Assign root cause and an owner distinct from the Insurance Product Manager who managed the gate.
Set a remediation date and carry open items into the next cycle's test.
testing.done: every exception has an issue, root cause, owner and remediation date.

testing.step: Conclude, sign and report the test
actions: Compute the exception rate against the zero-tolerance-for-use-before-clearance threshold.
Write the conclusion with evidence references.
Have the independent reviewer, who managed no sampled gate, sign the workpaper.
Report to the Compliance Committee and file in the compliance evidence repository.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with stated conclusion exists in the repository.

actions: Generate a test Evidence of Coverage, Summary of Benefits and Coverage, and any rider from pre-production for each affected plan.
Compare the generated document text, form number and edition date to the approved filed form.
Log any discrepancy for correction before promotion.
checklist.done: generated test documents match the approved filed forms exactly, including form number and edition date.

checklist.step: Validate CSR variant administration end-to-end
actions: Run a test enrollment through each CSR eligibility category — 73%, 87%, 94% AV, and standard — and confirm the system applies the correct cost-sharing structure.
Confirm the CSR variant plan ID generated matches the CMS-assigned variant ID from the QHP certification.
Log any category applying the wrong cost-sharing structure as a critical defect.
checklist.done: every CSR eligibility category applies the correct cost-sharing structure and variant ID in the test environment.

checklist.step: Confirm no lifetime/annual dollar limit is configured
actions: Inspect the plan design configuration for any dollar-cap field on essential health benefits.
Confirm the field is null/disabled for every EHB category, consistent with 45 CFR 156.410/156.420.
Have a second Configuration Engineer independently confirm the same plans.
checklist.done: no dollar-cap field is configured on any essential health benefit, confirmed by a second reviewer.

checklist.step: Get Product / Filing Actuary sign-off on rate configuration
actions: Review the pre-production rate validation results against the approved rate table.
Sign off that the configured rates match the approved filing exactly, with no unapproved rounding or factor substitution.
Return for rework any mismatch before promotion is scheduled.
checklist.done: the Product / Filing Actuary has signed off that rate configuration matches the approved filing.

checklist.step: Get Compliance sign-off on form and CSR configuration
actions: Review the form validation and CSR variant test results.
Confirm no EHB dollar-cap finding is open.
Sign off configuration for promotion to production.
checklist.done: Compliance sign-off is recorded with no open EHB or form-mismatch finding.

checklist.step: Promote the configuration to production
actions: Schedule the production release within the change-management window, timed to complete before September 30 and before Open Enrollment quoting begins.
Execute the promotion following the standard release runbook, including a rollback plan.
Record the production deployment date/time and the release ticket number on the system change record.
checklist.done: the configuration is promoted to production before September 30 with a recorded release ticket and rollback plan.

checklist.step: Run a post-implementation production validation
actions: Re-run the representative test-quote batch and document-generation test directly against production.
Confirm production output matches the pre-production validation results.
Log any production-only discrepancy, such as environment configuration drift, immediately.
checklist.done: production validation matches pre-production results, or a discrepancy is logged and corrected before go-live.

checklist.step: Confirm the effective-use date matches the release-gate record
actions: Verify the production system's effective-use date for the new rate/form matches the cleared gate's earliest-possible-use date.
Confirm no quote, bind or renewal transaction processed before that date used the new configuration.
Record the effective-use date confirmation on the system change record.
checklist.done: production effective-use date matches the gate record and no pre-date transaction used the new configuration.

checklist.step: Notify downstream teams of go-live
actions: Notify Underwriting, Claims and Contact Center Ops of the new plan/rate go-live date and any customer-facing document changes.
Update the Customer Self-Service Portal plan documents to the newly approved editions.
Confirm the notification includes the SERFF tracking number so downstream teams can trace back to the approved filing.
checklist.done: downstream teams and the customer self-service portal reflect the go-live configuration.

checklist.step: Log any configuration variance found in production as an exception
actions: Log any variance between production configuration and the approved filing found at any point after go-live.
Assign root cause, member impact and a correction plan, such as a re-rate and refund of affected policies.
Route to Regulatory Counsel for a self-report assessment if members were affected.
checklist.done: every production configuration variance is logged with root cause, impact and a correction plan.

checklist.step: Retain the implementation record
actions: File the system change record, pre-production and production validation results, sign-offs, and release ticket in the compliance evidence repository.
Apply the 7-year-from-withdrawal retention label.
Confirm the record is indexed by state, product and SERFF tracking number.
checklist.done: the implementation record is filed, retention-labeled and indexed.

testing.step: Build the population of production configuration changes
actions: Extract every production rate/plan/form configuration change with an effective date inside the test period.
Reconcile the count to the release-gate clearances for the same period.
Include configuration items delivered through emergency-hold overrides in the extract.
testing.done: population reconciles to release-gate clearance records.

testing.step: Reconcile each configuration change to an approved filing
actions: Match each population row to its approved filing package by SERFF tracking number.
List any configuration change with no matching approved filing as an automatic exception.
Confirm the matched filing's disposition date pre-dates the configuration's production deployment date.
testing.done: every configuration change matches an approved filing or is logged as an exception.

testing.step: Select the sample and document the selection method
actions: Take 100% of configuration changes with a logged post-go-live variance.
Take a random sample of 20 additional changes (seeded, reproducible).
Record the seed, the population size and the selection date.
testing.done: the sample is drawn and reproducible, covering all logged post-go-live variances.

testing.step: Re-perform the rate calculation test
actions: Independently run representative test quotes through the production rating engine for each sampled plan.
Recompute the expected premium from the approved rate table.
Compare and log any variance beyond rounding.
testing.done: independently computed premiums match production output or a variance is logged.

testing.step: Re-verify form and edition accuracy
actions: Generate a document from production for each sampled plan and compare to the approved filed form, including form number and edition date.
Log any text or edition mismatch.
Confirm the pre-production validation test on file covered the same sampled plan and edition.
testing.done: production-generated documents match approved filed forms or a mismatch is logged.

testing.step: Re-test CSR variant administration
actions: Run a test enrollment through each CSR eligibility category for sampled plans and confirm the correct cost-sharing structure and variant ID apply.
Compare to the CMS-assigned variant ID from the QHP certification.
Compare the result to the original pre-production CSR validation on file for the same plan.
testing.done: CSR variant administration is confirmed correct on the sample or a finding is logged.

testing.step: Re-verify no EHB dollar cap is configured
actions: Independently inspect the production plan design configuration for sampled plans for any dollar-cap field on essential health benefits.
Confirm none is configured; treat any hit as a critical, zero-tolerance finding.
Confirm the second-reviewer sign-off from implementation is on file for each sampled plan.
testing.done: no sampled plan shows an EHB dollar-cap configuration, or a critical finding is escalated immediately.

testing.step: Confirm effective-use date and pre-date transaction integrity
actions: Confirm the production effective-use date for sampled changes matches the release-gate record.
Query for any quote/bind/renewal transaction dated before the effective-use date that used the new configuration.
Where a pre-date transaction is found, trace the member impact and confirm a correction was logged.
testing.done: effective-use dates match the gate record and no pre-date transaction used the new configuration, or a breach is logged.

testing.step: Log every exception with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise a tracker issue per exception found in testing.
Assign root cause and an owner distinct from the Implementation Specialist who built the configuration.
Set a remediation date and carry open items into the next cycle's test.
testing.done: every exception has an issue, root cause, owner and remediation date.

testing.step: Conclude, sign and report the test
actions: Compute the exception rate against the zero-tolerance-for-EHB-cap and zero-tolerance-for-pre-date-use thresholds.
Write the conclusion with evidence references.
Have the independent reviewer, who built no sampled configuration, sign the workpaper.
Report to the Compliance Committee and file in the compliance evidence repository.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with stated conclusion exists in the repository.
